subject: Request: additional sandbox quota & trial extension — Storix POC
messages:
From: Alana Cruz <alana@storix.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: poc-team@storix.ai
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: additional sandbox quota & trial extension — Storix POC

Hi Marcus,

Quick note from the Storix engineering team: we hit an unexpected blocker with our Okta integration and the connector that pulls historical events. The blocker has pushed our internal demo and model-tuning work out by ~2 weeks. We were planning to finish the Redwood-powered POC by next Tuesday for the exec review, but with the SSO cert negotiation and a flaky staging connector we're not going to make that window.

Can Storix request a one-time sandbox top-up (extra 200k token quota) and a 14-day trial extension so we can complete the integration and re-run the quality checks? We're still committed to the POC and want to avoid churn from a rushed demo. I attached our updated POC plan and the latest sandbox usage CSV for context.

Appreciate any help — Alana

--
Alana Cruz
Head of Product, Storix AI
alana@storix.ai | +1 415-555-0172

Attachments:
- POC-plan-storix-v2.pdf (summary + revised timeline)
- sandbox-usage-report.csv (last 7 days)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Alana Cruz <alana@storix.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 9 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: additional sandbox quota & trial extension — Storix POC

Hi Alana — thanks for the heads up and for sending the usage report. Sorry to hear about the Okta/connector mess; we've seen those bite timelines more than once.

Quick plan from our side:
- I'll escalate for a small, one-off sandbox top-up while we validate it's actually being consumed for the POC (no automatic renewals).
- Could you confirm the exact new go-live/demo date you want to target after the 2-week slip? That helps us set the extension end date.
- Copying Marissa and Evelyn for approvals on credits and an extension to the trial window.

Proposed ask from Storix (for clarity): 200k extra token quota + 14-day extension to the trial end date. If you can confirm the post-slip demo date and that the extra tokens will be dedicated to model tuning + replay of the connector backlog, I will start the approval thread.

Best,
Marcus
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0199

Marcus / Evelyn —

I reviewed the usage attachment and ran the POC traffic pattern through our quota model. Storix's current spend profile suggests the requested 200k tokens will cover the connector replay + extra tuning runs they need. My recommendation: approve a one-time 200k token top-up and a 14-day trial extension, conditional on:

- We mark the top-up as non-recurring and flagged in billing as "POC top-up - Storix"
- A joint checkpoint on day 7 to confirm consumption aligns with POC goals (Marissa to set calendar)
- No SLA or credit precedent created — this is an exception for visible POC risk reduction

If you're good, I can provision the top-up and update their trial end date to 2027-05-26 (14 days from new target). Also recommending we add a small clause in HubSpot notes: "POC extension due to Okta/connector integration delays".

Marissa
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Approval: Storix one-time POC top-up + trial extension

Marcus / Marissa / Alana —

Approved. Per Marissa's recommendation I authorize the one-time 200k token sandbox top-up and the 14-day extension to the trial window. Conditions below:

- Token top-up is non-recurring and will be flagged in billing as "POC top-up - Storix".
- Trial will be extended to 2027-05-26; Storix must confirm the post-slip demo date by EOD 5/13 so we can schedule the day-7 checkpoint.
- If we detect anomalous consumption patterns inconsistent with the POC (e.g., burst usage > 3x typical POC runs), we reserve the right to pause additional provisioning and request a brief sync.

Alana — we'll provision the top-up this afternoon and send a confirmation once the tokens are added. Marissa will set the day-7 checkpoint invite. Good luck on the integration; ping me if you need a technical contact.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
